strings.aNo: UMantshi nguye onqumayo. Ukusebenzisa i-inFORMed akuqinisekisi ukuthi inkantolo izowunikeza umyalelo, noma ukuthi amaphoyisa azowuphoqelela.
strings.aS1: Yisa ifomu lakho kumabhalane kunoma iyiphi iNkantolo kaMantshi, ngezikhathi zenkantolo (imvamisa kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni kuya ku-3:30 ntambama ngezinsuku zomsebenzi). Uma usengozini, ungafaka isicelo nangemuva kwamahora omsebenzi. Kumahhala, futhi awudingi ummeli.
strings.aS2: Umabhalane ulihlola nawe. Ulisayina phambi kukakhomishana wezifungo.
strings.aS3: UMantshi uyalifunda, ngokuvamile ngalo lolo suku. Uma uMantshi ebona ukuthi udinga ukuvikelwa manje, ukunika umyalelo wokuvikela wesikhashana.
strings.aS4: Umyalelo wesikhashana unikezwa yena ngusherifu noma ngamaphoyisa. Ukuvikela kusukela ngesikhathi ewuthola.
strings.aS5: Unikezwa usuku lokubuyela enkantolo. Ngalolo suku nobabili ningeza enkantolo, futhi uMantshi unquma ukuthi uzowunikeza yini umyalelo wokuvikela wokugcina. Qiniseka ukuthi uya enkantolo ngalolo suku.
strings.aS6: Uma ephula umyalelo, kubike esiteshini samaphoyisa osibhale efomini lakho. Angaboshwa.
strings.aboutG1: I-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech) yinhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika yobuchwepheshe be-feminist esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukusekela abasinde odlameni olubhekiswe kubulili nokusiza abantu bathole ulwazi, usizo nezinsiza mayelana namalungelo abo, impilo nenhlalakahle.
strings.aboutI1: I-inFORMed ithuluzi le-GRIT le-AI elisiza ezindabeni zomthetho. Ikhuluma njengelungu lomphakathi elinakekelayo, ayiphuthumi futhi ayahluleli, futhi isiza abantu ababhekene nodlame lwasekhaya ukufaka okwenzeka kubo esicelweni inkantolo engasisebenza.
strings.aboutI2: Iseluleko sayo sisekelwe efomini elisemthethweni lesicelo somyalelo wokuvikela, emihlahlandleleni mayelana namalungelo odlame lwasekhaya nokubhala isicelo esiqinile, ocwaningweni lwe-MOSAIC lokuthi omantshi babhekeni, nasemhlahlandleleni we-GRIT wemiyalelo yokuvikela.
strings.askDesc: Qonda imiyalelo yokuvikela, inqubo yasenkantolo namagama asemthethweni.
strings.askOpening: Sawubona, ngingu-inFORMed. Ngiyi-AI chatbot, angiyena umuntu. Angikwazi ukunikeza iseluleko somthetho. Ngingachaza ukuthi imiyalelo yokuvikela isebenza kanjani, ukuthi amagama asemthethweni asho ukuthini, nokuthi yini elindelekile enkantolo. Ungathanda ukwazi ini?
strings.bringA1: Incwadi kamazisi noma iphasipoti yakho (noma yimuphi umazisi onawo)
strings.bringA2: Lesi sicelo, neFomu 6A (imininingwane yakho) ligcinwe lodwa
strings.bringA3: Konke okwaziyo ngaye: igama eligcwele, inombolo kamazisi, ikheli lasekhaya nelomsebenzi, inombolo yocingo, inombolo yemoto, isithombe
strings.bringA4: Noma yimiphi imiyalelo yokuvikela yangaphambili, izinombolo zamacala (CAS) noma ze-OB
strings.bringNote: Ungafaka isicelo ngisho ungenazo lezi zinto. Phatha amakhophi bese ugcina okwangempela kuphephile.
strings.cHome: Buyela ekhasini lasekhaya? Ifomu lakho lizosulwa kuleli khasi

strings.cStartOver: Qala kabusha? Lokhu kusula ifomu kuleli khasi.
strings.chHelpMsg: Angiqiniseki ukuthi yikuphi okufanele ngikukhethe. Ungangisiza?

strings.fillOpening:
Sawubona, Ngingu InFormed. Ngiyi- AI Chatbot hhayi umuntu. Angikwazi ukukweluleka.

Ngingakusiza ngokugcwalisa i-Protection Order Form.

✔ Isitori sakho ngizosibenzisela iForm yakho.
✔ Uyazikhethela ukuth yin ofuna ukukhuluma ngayo.
✔ I form yakho iyagcwaliseka ube usachaza ukuth kwenzakaleni, uchaza kanye uqede.
✔ Ciphiza QUICK Exit uma ufuna ukusheshe uphume lana.

Usenkingeni name? Fonela 10111
strings.fillStart:
Ngitshele ukuthi kwenzekani. Ungabhala noma ukhulume.

Isibonelo: “Owayeyisoka lami uhlala engisongela. Ngifuna ahlale kude nami.”
strings.footNote: I-inFORMed ikusiza ulungise isicelo sakho somyalelo wokuvikela. Akusona iseluleko somthetho futhi asithathi indawo yomabhalane wenkantolo noma yommeli.
strings.footPw: Kunikezwa yi-GRIT · Gender Rights in Tech
strings.g1: Emsebenzini ogxile kubasindile nonakekela ukuhlukumezeka, lapho ukuphepha nezidingo zabasindile kusenhliziyweni yobuchwepheshe nezinhlelo zayo.
strings.g2: Ekwakheni ndawonye nemiphakathi, kuhlanganise abesifazane abasebasha, abasindile nabantu abanolwazi olusiza ukuklama amathuluzi.
strings.g3: Osizweni lwedijithali olufinyelelekayo, kuhlanganise uZuzi, ingxoxo esebenza nge-AI ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza lwe-GRIT, kanye nosizo lwe-WhatsApp namanye amathuluzi edijithali.
strings.g4: Ekufinyeleleni ukuphepha nosizo, kuhlanganise izici ezifana ne-Panic Button ne-Evidence Vault ohlelweni lokusebenza lwe-GRIT.
strings.generalInfo: Ulwazi olujwayelekile, aluveli emihlahlandleleni ye-GRIT. Sicela uqinisekise nomabhalane wenkantolo.
strings.guideAudio: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, evela ku-GRIT. Le webhusayithi ikusiza ukugcwalisa ifomu lasenkantolo lomyalelo wokuvikela. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo. Ukuze uqale, cindezela inkinobho enkulu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ethi: Qala ifomu lami. Bese uxoxa indaba yakho. Akudingeki ubhale. Cindezela imakrofoni bese ukhuluma, bese uyicindezela futhi uma usuqedile. Bese ucindezela ethi Yizwa ukuze ulalele lokho okuzwakele, bese ucindezela ethi Thumela uma kulungile, noma ethi Phinda ukusho. Uma uvula ethi Funda ngezwi, yonke impendulo izofundwa kuwe. Uma usengozini manje, shayela amaphoyisa ku-1 0 1 1 1, noma cindezela inkinobho ebomvu ethi Phuma ngokushesha phezulu ukuze uphume kule webhusayithi masinyane.
strings.hSadag: I-SADAG, usizo lwabacabanga ukuzibulala, amahora angu-24
strings.hTg: Xoxa ne-inFORMed, bhala noma uthumele imiyalezo yezwi
strings.hfIntro: Nasi isicelo sakho, sifundwa ngezwi. Yilokhu ozofunga ngakho enkantolo. Ungacindezela ethi Misa noma nini. Uma kukhona okungalungile noma okushodayo, ngitshele engxoxweni, noma ukushintshe efomini.
strings.hfIntroTr: Nasi isicelo sakho, sihunyushelwe esiZulwini ukuze usizwe. Ifomu uqobo lihlala ngesiNgisi, ngoba lifakwa enkantolo ngesiNgisi. Yilokhu ozofunga ngakho enkantolo. Ungacindezela ethi Misa noma nini. Uma kukhona okungalungile noma okushodayo, ngitshele engxoxweni.
strings.howSub: Omantshi badinga imininingwane ecacile ukuze banikeze umyalelo wokuvikela. I-inFORMed ikusiza ukuyinikeza, ngaphandle kokuthi ingxoxo izizwe njengefomu.
strings.iP1: I-inFORMed iyi-AI chatbot eyenziwe yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Ayiyena umuntu noma ummeli, futhi ayinikezi iseluleko somthetho. Ikusiza ukulungisa isalungiswa sefomu elisemthethweni lasenkantolo. Umabhalane eNkantolo kaMantshi ulihlola nawe ngaphambi kokuthi usayine.
strings.iP2: Ukuze ikuphendule, i-inFORMed ithumela imilayezo yakho ku-OpenAI, inkampani ene-AI esetshenziswayo. I-GRIT ayiyiboni futhi ayiyigcini imilayezo yakho. I-OpenAI icelwa ukuthi ingayigcini, futhi ayisetshenziselwa ukuqeqesha noma iyiphi i-AI.
strings.iP3: Ingxoxo ayigcinwa nhlobo: iyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. Ifomu lakho ligcinwa kule foni kuphela, ekhasini elivuliwe, ngakho ukulayisha kabusha ikhasi akulilahli. Uma ukhetha ethi “Londoloza ukuze uqedele kamuva”, likhiywa nge-PIN oyikhethayo futhi lihlala kule foni uze ulisuse. Akekho ongalivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, ngisho ne-GRIT. I-PIN ekhohliwe ayikwazi ukutholakala.
strings.iP4: Cindezela ethi Qala kabusha noma Phuma ngokushesha ukuze usule ikhasi. Ukuze ususe ifomu eligciniwe, cindezela ethi “Qhubeka nesicelo esigciniwe” ekhasini lokuqala, faka i-PIN yakho bese ukhetha ethi “Lisuse”. Ifayela le-PDF noma le-Word olilandile lihlala kokulandiwe kwefoni yakho uze ulisuse.
strings.iP5: Omunye umuntu osebenzisa le foni angabona emlandweni wesiphequluli ukuthi uvakashele i-inFORMed, noma athole ifomu olilandile. Uma lokho kuyingozi, sebenzisa ithebhu eyimfihlo (incognito), susa okulandiwe ngemuva kokukusebenzisa, bese usula umlando wesiphequluli. Ifomu eligcinwe nge-PIN lihlala likhiyiwe. Ethebhu eyimfihlo, ifomu eligciniwe liyalahleka uma uvala ithebhu.
strings.iP6: Shayela amaphoyisa ku-10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428. Zombili zimahhala. Ungasebenzisa ne-app ye-GRIT, enenkinobho yokuphuthuma ekuxhumanisa nosizo.
strings.k1: Ungafaka isicelo somyalelo wokuvikela ngokwakho, mahhala, ngaphandle kommeli futhi ngaphandle kokuvula icala emaphoyiseni kuqala.
strings.k2: Ufaka isicelo eNkantolo kaMantshi lapho uhlala khona, usebenza noma ufunda khona, lapho omunye umuntu ehlala noma esebenza khona, noma lapho ukuhlukunyezwa kwenzeka khona.
strings.k2s: Izikhathi zenkantolo zivame ukuba ngu-9 ekuseni kuya ku-3:30 ntambama phakathi nesonto. Uma usengozini ungafaka isicelo ngemva kwalezo zikhathi.
strings.k3: Udlame lwasekhaya alukhona nje ukulimala komzimba. Lufaka ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo, ngokwezimali nangokocansi, ukuhlukumeza, ukwesabisa nokulawula.
strings.k4: Izithombe, izincwadi zikadokotela noma ofakazi bangasiza, kodwa ungafaka isicelo nangaphandle kwazo. Ingane yanoma iyiphi iminyaka nayo ingafaka isicelo.
strings.learnH: Ufuna ukwazi kabanzi ngaphambi kokuthi uqale?
strings.learnP: Buza noma yini mayelana nemiyalelo yokuvikela, inkantolo, noma amagama asemthethweni. Bhala noma khuluma, futhi ungalalela yonke impendulo.
strings.lede: Sitshele okwenzekile ngokukhuluma noma ngokubhala. Sigcwalisa ifomu lasenkantolo nawe, umbuzo owodwa ngesikhathi. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo.

strings.protection-order.openingFill:
Sawubona, ngiyi-inFORMed. Ngiyi-AI chatbot, angiyena umuntu. Angikwazi ukunikeza izeluleko zomthetho.

Ngingakusiza ugcwalise ifomu le-protection order, okuwumyalelo wenkantolo wokukuvikela.

✔ Indaba yakho isetshenziselwa ifomu lakho kuphela.
✔ Nguwe okhetha ukuthi wabelana ngani.
✔ Ifomu lakho liyagcwaliseka njengoba sixoxa, ngakho uyixoxa kanye kuphela indaba yakho.
✔ Le ngxoxo igcinwa amahora angu-24 ukuze sikwazi ukuqhubeka, bese iyasulwa. Thumela u-{del} ukuze uyisule manje.

Usengozini manje? Shayela u-10111.
strings.protection-order.ready: Nasi isicelo sakho esisalungiswa. Siyise kumabhalane wenkantolo kunoma iyiphi i-Magistrates’ Court. Ukufaka isicelo kumahhala. Awudingi ummeli noma ukuvula icala emaphoyiseni.
strings.protection-order.welcome: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, umsizi wakho wokuthola i-protection order (umyalelo wenkantolo wokukuvikela), ohlinzekwa yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Iluphi ulimi ofuna ukulusebenzisa?
strings.pv1: Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana lokho. Kwenzeka nini, uma ukhumbula?
strings.pv2: NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku, mhla zi-2. Cishe ngo-11.
strings.pv3: Ngiyabonga, lowo mniningwane usiza kakhulu inkantolo. Ingabe walimala?
strings.pvEmpty: Akukho okugcwalisiwe okwamanje. Tshela i-inFORMed okwenzekile, futhi isicelo sakho sizogcwaliswa njengoba ukhuluma.
strings.pvSum: Izingxenye ezingu-{f} kwezingu-{t} zigcwalisiwe. Ungashintsha noma yini kuphaneli yefomu, noma uqhubeke ukhuluma ukuze wengeze okunye.

strings.rN1: Yisa uhlaka lwakho kumabhalane eNkantolo kaMantshi ngezikhathi zenkantolo (ngokuvamile ngu-9 ekuseni kuya ku-3:30 ntambama phakathi nesonto).
strings.rN2: Umabhalane ukusiza ugcwalise ifomu elisemthethweni. Usayina phambi kukakhomishana wezifungo.
strings.rN3: Uma inkantolo inikeza umyalelo wesikhashana, unikezwa umuntu obekwa icala, futhi wena unikezwa usuku lokubuyela enkantolo.
strings.restoredPin: Kubuyiselwe. Ukuze uqhubeke uvuselela ikhophi egcinwe nge-PIN, khetha “Gcina ukuze uqede kamuva” futhi.
strings.s1d: Yabelana ngokwenzekile ngamazwi akho nangolimi lwakho. I-inFORMed ibuza umbuzo owodwa omnene ngesikhathi, futhi ungama noma nini.
strings.s2d: Yonke imininingwane ingena engxenyeni efanele yefomu lenkantolo, ibhalwe ngendlela omantshi abayidingayo: izinsuku, izindawo, okwashiwo, nokuthi izinto ziya ngokuba zimbi kanjani.
strings.s3d: Landa isicelo sakho njenge-PDF noma idokhumenti ye-Word, usiyise kumabhalane eNkantolo kaMantshi. Ungahlola futhi ushintshe noma yini kuqala.
strings.sBody: Isicelo sakho sizovalwa nge-PIN futhi sigcinwe kule divayisi kuphela. Akekho ongasivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, futhi asithunyelwa ku-GRIT. Ingxoxo yona ayigcinwa.
strings.sErrMatch: Ama-PIN amabili awafani. Sicela uzame futhi.
strings.sErrShort: Sicela usebenzise okungenani izinombolo noma izinhlamvu ezingu-6.
strings.sPin1: Khetha i-PIN (okungenani izinombolo noma izinhlamvu ezingu-6)
strings.sSmall: Uma ukhohlwa i-PIN, isicelo esigciniwe ngeke sivuleke. Khetha into umuntu oseduze nawe angeke ayiqagele.
strings.safety.death: Ngiyi-chatbot, futhi lokhu kuzwakala njengesimo esiphuthumayo esidinga usizo lomuntu. Uma unesikhathi sokuhlela ukuthi ungaphuma kanjani engozini, ngibuze ngohlelo lokuphepha. Uma kuyisimo esiphuthumayo futhi udinga usizo njengamanje, shayela i-ambulensi ku-10177 noma amaphoyisa ku-10111. Lezi zinombolo zimahhala, ngakho awudingi i-airtime. Ungaphinda ulande i-app ye-GRIT ezokuxhumanisa nosizo usebenzisa lesi sixhumanisi: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele noma iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.fallback: Ngiyaxolisa, ngibe nenkinga yokuphendula njengamanje. Uma usengozini, shayela amaphoyisa ku-10111, noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (mahhala, amahora angu-24). Sicela uzame ukuthumela umyalezo wakho futhi.
strings.safety.goodbye: Uma uba neminye imibuzo, sicela ubuye uzobuza. Ngilapha ukuze ngikusize noma nini lapho udinga usizo. Usale kahle okwamanje!
strings.safety.harm_other: Kumele ukuthi usezinhlungwini ezinkulu ukuze uzizwe ngale ndlela. Ngiyi-chatbot, ngakho angihlali ngikwazi ukuqonda imizwa yabantu. Ithimba le-GRIT likwazi kahle ukusebenza nemizwa enzima nebuhlungu. Sicela ubathumelele umyalezo ku-WhatsApp ku-072 737 8819.
strings.safety.immediate_danger: Ngiyi-chatbot, futhi lokhu kuzwakala njengesimo esiphuthumayo esidinga usizo lomuntu. Uma unesikhathi sokuhlela ukuthi ungaphuma kanjani engozini, ngibuze ngohlelo lokuphepha. Uma kuyisimo esiphuthumayo futhi udinga usizo njengamanje, shayela i-ambulensi ku-10177 noma amaphoyisa ku-10111. Lezi zinombolo zimahhala, ngakho awudingi i-airtime. Ungaphinda ulande i-app ye-GRIT ezokuxhumanisa nosizo usebenzisa lesi sixhumanisi: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele noma iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.injured_now: Ngiyi-chatbot, futhi lokhu kuzwakala njengesimo esiphuthumayo esidinga usizo lomuntu. Uma unesikhathi sokuhlela ukuthi ungaphuma kanjani engozini, ngibuze ngohlelo lokuphepha. Uma kuyisimo esiphuthumayo futhi udinga usizo njengamanje, shayela i-ambulensi ku-10177 noma amaphoyisa ku-10111. Lezi zinombolo zimahhala, ngakho awudingi i-airtime.
strings.safety.rape: Akekho umuntu ofanele ukudlula kulokhu obhekene nakho. Akulona iphutha lakho. Ngingakusiza kanjani?
strings.safety.suicidal: Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu ngokuthi uzizwa ufuna ukuzibulala, kodwa ngiyajabula kakhulu ukuthi uzizwe ukwazi ukukhuluma ngakho. Angiyena umuntu, ngakho kungenzeka ngingakwazi ukukusiza ngendlela ekuqonda kahle konke obhekene nakho. Nansi inombolo ye-SADAG. Awudingi i-airtime ukuze ushayele, futhi kukhona umuntu ongakusiza 24/7. Inombolo yabo ithi 0800 567 567. Ungabheka newebhusayithi yabo: https://www.sadag.org
strings.safety.support: Uma udinga ukukhuluma nomuntu manje, i-GBV Command Centre imahhala futhi ivulekile amahora angu-24: 0800 428 428. Ungabuye uthumele i-WhatsApp ku-GRIT ku-072 737 8819. Singama noma nini uma udinga.
strings.safety.tracking: Anginiki muntu imininingwane yakho. Ingxoxo yethu ayigcinwa ngemva kokuba uyivalile.
strings.saveDemo: Ukugcina kusebenza engxoxweni yangempela, hhayi emboniso.
strings.saveKept: Ifomu lakho liyagcinwa uma ikhasi liphinde lilayishwe.
strings.savedPinGo: Kugcinwe kule divayisi nge-PIN yakho. Izinguquko zigcinwa njengoba uqhubeka.
strings.serverErr: Uxolo, angikwazanga ukufinyelela iseva manje. Sicela uzame futhi. Uma usengozini, shayela u-10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428.
strings.toAsk: Ngibuze noma yini mayelana nemiyalelo yokuvikela. Ifomu lakho ligciniwe, futhi ungabuyela kulo noma nini.
strings.toFill: Asiqhubeke nesicelo sakho. Ifomu lakho ligcinwe ngakwesokudla.
strings.typesNone: Izinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa zizovela lapha njengoba ziphuma.
strings.underDemo: Umboniso: umuntu ongekho ngempela nengxoxo ebhaliwe.
strings.underLive: Ingxoxo yakho iyimfihlo. Ingxoxo ayigcinwa, kodwa ifomu lakho liyagcinwa uma ikhasi liphinde lilayishwe.
strings.vCheck: Hlola engikuzwile futhi ushintshe noma yini, bese ucindezela uthumele.
strings.vFail: Uxolo, angikuzwanga kahle. Sicela uzame futhi, noma ubhale.
strings.vListen: Ngiyalalela… cindezela imakrofoni ebomvu uma usuqedile.
strings.vListenT: Ngiyalalela… {t}. Cindezela imakrofoni ebomvu uma usuqedile.
strings.vNear: Ngiyalalela… {t}. Sekucishe kube imizuzu emi-3: cindezela imakrofoni ebomvu maduze. Ungaqopha okunye ngemuva.
strings.vNoSupport: Uxolo, izwi alisebenzi kulesi siphequluli. Sicela ubhale.
strings.vPerm: Ngidinga imvume yokusebenzisa imakrofoni yakho. Ungayivumela esipheqululini sakho, noma ubhale.
strings.vQ: Yilokhu okushilo? Ungashintsha amagama, noma uwalalele.
strings.wa.askMore: Ungathayipha, noma uthumele i-voice note. Uma ufuna usizo ngesicelo sakho, thumela u-FILL.
strings.wa.code: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, ehlinzekwa yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Sicela uthumele ikhodi yokungena oyinikiwe.
strings.wa.docFail: Ngiyaxolisa, angikwazanga ukuthumela idokhumenti njengamanje. Sicela uzame futhi.
strings.wa.general: — Ulwazi olujwayelekile, aluveli emihlahlandle ye-GRIT. Sicela uqinisekise nomabhalane wenkantolo.
strings.wa.help:
Ungathayipha noma uthumele i-voice note noma nini. Ungaphinda uthumele:
ASK {about}
FILL ukuze uthole usizo lokugcwalisa isicelo sakho
FORM ukuze ubone isicelo sakho njengoba sinjalo kuze kube manje
PDF noma WORD ukuze usithole njengedokhumenti
LANGUAGE ukuze ushintshe ulimi
DELETE ukuze usule le ngxoxo

Uma usengozini njengamanje, shayela amaphoyisa ku-10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (mahhala, amahora angu-24).
strings.wa.textOnly: Ngiyakwazi ukufunda imiyalezo ebhaliwe nokuzwa ama-voice note. Sicela uthayiphe, noma uthumele i-voice note.
strings.wa.voiceFail: Ngiyaxolisa, angikwazanga ukuyizwa kahle leyo voice note. Sicela uzame futhi, noma uthayiphe umyalezo wakho.
strings.welcomeBack: Wamukelekile futhi. Isicelo sakho sinjengoba usishiye, futhi ungasibona ngakwesokudla. Siqhubeke? Ungangitshela noma yini ofuna ukuyengeza noma ukuyishintsha.
